SELECT 
  d_assessment.id_assessment,
  d_assessment.due_day,
  ROUND(SUM(fas.score) / COUNT(fas.score), 1) AS mean_score
FROM 
  dim_assessment
JOIN 
  fact_assessment_submission fas ON d_assessment.assessment_key = fas.assessment_key
WHERE 
  d_assessment.code_module = 'AAA' AND d_assessment.code_presentation = '2013J'
GROUP BY 
  d_assessment.id_assessment, d_assessment.due_day
raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  d_assessment.id_assessment,
  d_assessment.due_day,
  ROUND(SUM(fas.score) / COUNT(fas.score), 1) AS mean_score
FROM 
  dim_assessment
JOIN 
  fact_assessment_submission fas ON d_assessment.assessment_key = fas.assessment_key
WHERE 
  d_assessment.code_module = 'AAA' AND d_assessment.code_presentation = '2013J'
GROUP BY 
  d_assessment.id_assessment, d_assessment.due_day;
```

sql:
WITH ROLLUP AS (
  SELECT 
    code_module,
    code_presentation,
    SUM(total_clicks) AS total_clicks
  FROM 
    agg_pres_week_activity
  GROUP BY 
    code_module, code_presentation
  WITH ROLLUP
)
SELECT 
  code_module,
  code_presentation,
  total_clicks
FROM 
  ROLLUP
ORDER BY 
  code_module, code_presentation
raw:
```sql

)
```
